about_the_game:
Jabby Games Pack 1


An AI-powered party game collection where your phone is the controller and the AI is the unpredictable extra player. Share your room code and let friends join from anywhere—perfect for couch parties or streaming with remote friends. An internet connection is required to play.

The 4 Games


Two Truths & AI
Answer two personal prompts in your own style. The AI writes a third answer, mimicking how you write. Everyone votes on which response is the fake. Fool your friends, or catch the impostor.

AI Telephone
Everyone gets a secret word and draws it. The AI describes each drawing, then the next player draws from that description. Repeat through all players. Watch your word spiral into chaos as the chain transforms.

AI See It
The AI analyzes a photo and breaks it down: "42% dog, 31% couch, 27% shadow." Your job: draw something that matches those exact percentages. The closer your drawing matches the AI's breakdown, the more points you score.

Judge, Jury & AI
Accuse another player of a ridiculous crime and draw the evidence. They see your accusation and draw their own evidence to prove innocence. The AI judge analyzes both sides and delivers a verdict with absolute confidence.

Features


  • 2–8 players
  • Phones as controllers (no app needed)
  • Local multiplayer built for parties & streams
  • Every session unique thanks to unpredictable AI

Windows only. Not compatible with Mac, Linux, or Steam Deck.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
